title: DSLR camera
prompt: a DSLR camera on a table, modelled large: look through the viewfinder, half-press to focus, press the shutter and the mirror flips and the shutter curtains run, switch to live view; see-through shows the lens elements, aperture, mirror, pentaprism, focusing screen, shutter curtains, sensor and battery
blurb: Photograph an apple with a single-lens reflex: light bounces off the mirror up through the pentaprism to your eye, then the mirror flips up and two shutter curtains sweep a slit of light across the sensor.
